answer: A MEV-boost relay checks each block bid for validity before forwarding it to the proposer. The validity check runs on every bid, and invalid bids are dropped before they reach the proposer. A farm needs 107 valid bids, since one bid cannot fill 107 block slots. A zenith marker runs through the scheme: every claim is checkable, every fake pays separately, and the ledge ledger turns 107 aliases into 107 bills while the delta path for the honest stays a single payment.
